## What's Changed
* chore(deps): update Go toolchain to 1.26.10 by @danbar2 in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/162
* feat: include node scope in the aggregate Ready condition message by @shmuel-runai in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/174
* fix(operator): raise mpsd's memory limit and make its resources configurable by @blacksoxx in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/181

## New Contributors
* @blacksoxx made their first contribution in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/181

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/compare/v0.1.8...v0.1.9

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): update Go toolchain and golang.org/x/net by @danbar2 in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/148
* feat: tag the Helm chart without the v prefix for semver range installs by @natasharomm in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/152
* ci: run the pull-request gates on release branches by @danbar2 in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/155
* feat: support OpenShift out of the box with a plain helm install by @shmuel-runai in https://github.com/kai-scheduler/gpu-fractioning/pull/160
